title: notes-to-self-2026-03-04
body:
Morning scratchpad - 2026-03-04

Top priorities
- PR review: serving-runtime #1234 (kernel selection fallback). Quick pass before EOD. Note: pay attention to tests around variable seqlen handling (Samira's comments).
- Follow up with SRE about dedicated pool autoscale policy — ask for logs from 2026-03-02 incident, ETA for fix (ticket INF-482).
- Run NPU vs GPU batch throughput comparison for small-seq workloads. Steps: checkout branch local/quant-eval, run bench script with --seq 128 --batch 8, collect p50/p95 latency, token/s. Save CSV to /tmp/bench-0304.

Standup notes (to mention)
- Autoscale policy is still noisy; had a spike at 11:32 on Tuesday that dropped requests to fallback models. Working with SRE.
- Experiment: prefix caching reduces token cost ~12% in perf test but increases mem pressure. Need more runs.
- Drafting a short blurb for product about Dedicated burst capacity options (one-pager).

TODO (personal + work)
- [ ] Finish PR review and push small fixes
- [ ] Ping SRE (Riley) for logs / next steps
- [ ] Run bench and upload CSV to bench-results board
- [ ] Write one-pager draft for product (outline + key metrics)
- [ ] Order new keyboard wrist rest (work-from-home ergonomics)
- [ ] Pick up groceries: milk, eggs, spinach, coffee
- [ ] Call dentist to confirm appointment on 2026-03-10

Quick notes / reminders
- QA: when comparing quant profiles, ensure identical tokenization and max_new_tokens. Avoid comparing with streaming on/off.
- If fallback to smaller model happens, check model-version pinning in rollout config; common mistake: missing alias mapping.
- Slack threads to scan: #infra-incidents, #serving-runtime, thread by @maya about model catalog benchmarks.

Questions / unresolved
- Does Dedicated autoscale policy support per-customer PBQ (preemptible burst quota) yet? If not, propose adding to roadmap.
- Follow up: are there any E2E tests that simulate KV cache hot-path under high concurrency? If not, add an item to infra test backlog.

One-off commands to keep handy
- local bench: ./scripts/bench.sh --model redwood/bench-7b --seq 128 --batch 8 --out /tmp/bench-0304.csv
- inspect logs: gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND jsonPayload.component=autoscaler" --limit 50

Notes to self (style)
- Keep these notes short; move outcome items into proper tickets after done.
- When writing one-pager, include cost delta numbers and customer impact examples.

End of note.
